first_run_packets.candidate_title: Counterbalance familiar-entity priors against artificial values.
first_run_packets.containment_rule: If source-local lookup works without semantic competition, preserve it only as a familiar-key lookup diagnostic.
first_run_packets.death_rule: Kill if behavior reduces to local copy, semantic prior recall, authority wording, or parse/answer-shape effects.
dumb_explanations: The artificial value is just easier to copy than the semantic prior.
Entity familiarity is acting only as a prompt key, not as knowledge pressure.
Prompt wording still tells the model to trust the local source.
Output candidates or answer shape separate the labels.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if parseable_rate >= 0.90 and artificial_value_rate >= 0.85 on non-holdout and >= 0.75 on source-disjoint holdout.
panel_specs.purpose: Confirm artificial values are learnable from the local source without semantic-prior conflict.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass as an admission signal only if both branches appear in matched conflict rows and neither branch exceeds 0.90 globally.
panel_specs.purpose: Measure whether real-world priors compete with artificial values under matched wording.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if unknown_or_abstain_rate >= 0.80 and side_answer_rate <= 0.10.
panel_specs.purpose: Ensure the model does not emit artificial or prior values when the source is absent or irrelevant.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if holdout_parseable_rate >= 0.90, holdout_expected_rate >= 0.70, and both labels have at least 6 rows.
panel_specs.purpose: Check that behavior survives held-out familiar entities and artificial values.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if no simple output/candidate/shape baseline reaches 0.80 AUC on holdout labels.
panel_specs.purpose: Measure whether output or candidate margins explain the branch before hidden states.

first_run_packets.promotion_rule: Admit only if familiar priors measurably compete with local artificial values while prompt and output baselines fail to explain the split.

target_models.secondary_usage_rule: Do not run the secondary target until the primary behavior packet passes or produces a diagnostic worth widening.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if expected_branch_rate >= 0.70 and both local and learned branch labels have at least 24 rows.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if no single visible feature reaches 0.80 AUC and branch behavior degrades predictably under multi-feature ablation.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if unknown_rate >= 0.80 and side_answer_rate <= 0.10.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if holdout_expected_branch_rate >= 0.65 and both branch labels have at least 8 holdout rows.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if simple output/candidate/prompt-feature baselines do not explain the branch on holdout.
panel_specs.purpose: Report candidate and output geometry before any hidden-state work.

first_run_packets.promotion_rule: Admit only if direct controls, conflict mixture, nulls, prompt-channel audits, holdout, and output/candidate baselines pass together.

first_run_packets.candidate_title: Build grounded answerability before refusal or uncertainty probing.
first_run_packets.containment_rule: Contain as a refusal-template or output-geometry diagnostic if controls explain it.
first_run_packets.death_rule: Kill if abstention follows caution wording, answer schema, entity familiarity, or output margin.
dumb_explanations: Abstention is caused by the instruction style.
Known/unknown labels leak through entity or answer shape.
The model refuses because the prompt requests caution, not because evidence is absent.
Output margins separate answerable and unanswerable rows before any hidden signature.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if correct_rate >= 0.80 and parseable_rate >= 0.90.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if abstain_rate >= 0.70 and hallucination_rate <= 0.20.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if abstain_rate >= 0.65 and unsupported_answer_rate <= 0.20.
panel_specs.purpose: Test contexts that do not support the requested answer.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if corrected_rate + abstain_rate >= 0.70 and false_accept_rate <= 0.20.
panel_specs.purpose: Measure whether contradicted contexts cause correction, abstention, or false acceptance.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if answerable and unanswerable holdout panels each pass their branch floor.
panel_specs.purpose: Hold out entities, facts, and support contexts together.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if no requested-mode, margin, or shape baseline reaches 0.80 AUC.
panel_specs.purpose: Check requested-mode text, answer shape, and output margins before any signature work.

first_run_packets.promotion_rule: Admit only if answerability behavior survives prompt, requested-mode, label-balance, output-margin, null, and holdout gates.

first_run_packets.candidate_title: Test whether familiar-entity source lookup survives neutral rewrites.
first_run_packets.containment_rule: Contain as a source-channel diagnostic if lookup works but rewrite equivalence fails.
first_run_packets.death_rule: Kill if source deletion, query-only text, or prompt rewrite effects explain the behavior.

The query token or entity name alone carries the answer.
Rewrite differences change parseability rather than behavior.
The model follows instruction tone, not a source-value binding.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if rewrite_equivalence_rate >= 0.80 and delta_from_baseline <= 0.15.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if source_value_rate <= 0.10 after deletion.
panel_specs.purpose: Delete the source value and confirm the behavior disappears.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if query_proxy_rate <= 0.10.
panel_specs.purpose: Check whether entity/query text alone carries the answer.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass if holdout_equivalence_rate >= 0.75 and holdout_parseable_rate >= 0.90.
panel_specs.purpose: Hold out entities and rewrite forms together.

panel_specs.pass_rule: Pass only if no candidate, output, or rewrite-format baseline reaches 0.80 AUC on held-out labels.
panel_specs.purpose: Measure whether output or candidate geometry explains rewrite success.

first_run_packets.promotion_rule: Admit only if neutral rewrites preserve the behavior and source deletion/query-only controls fail to reproduce it.
